import qualified Data.Vector as V

  contents <- getContents
  let toks = words contents

                  concatMap (\(a, b) -> [(a, b), (b, a)]) edges
          d1 = S.fromList (filter (/= 1) (adj V.! 1))
          d2 = S.fromList (concat [ filter (/= 1) (adj V.! v) | v <- S.toList d1 ])
          ans = S.union d1 d2
      print (S.size ans)

chunk2 :: [Int] -> [(Int, Int)]
chunk2 (a : b : rest) = (a, b) : chunk2 rest
